items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: He had a drummer by the name of Johnny Williams. Johnny Williams, who I've heard from since, is Johnny Williams, who is the father of John Williams.

ctx.x: I know it and I can't think of it either. But it'll come.

Raymond Scott. Raymond Scott. He was with Raymond Scott. Raymond Scott. They were in California under contract to the studio that did The Little Dancer. The little gal. She was famous. and they were out there about 1937. They were there for two years. In fact, they had Shuby, Lou Shuby was the bass player. I don't know if you know Lou Shuby. Lou Shuby was a contractor at CBS. He took a leave of absence for two years. He had a drummer by the name of Johnny Williams. Johnny Williams, who I've heard from since, is…
